name: Jacob Scipio
bio:
Jacob Muntaz Scipio (born January 10, 1993) is an English actor and writer from London. In 2020, he played villain Armando Aretas in the action comedy Bad Boys for Life, directed by Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, and starring Will Smith and Martin Lawrence. In 2016, Scipio co-founded CPO Productions.
